name: Virtual Analog Crossfade
author: Emilie Gillet
description: One of Emilie Gillet's alternate virtual-analog designs preserved in the Plaits source: a waveform pair crossfading from detune through dry tone to hard sync.

controls.label: Detune
controls.description: Detunes the secondary oscillator through closely spaced and musical intervals.

controls.label: Detune to sync
controls.description: Moves the main output from a detuned pair through the dry primary to progressively harder synchronization.

controls.label: Common waveform
controls.description: Changes the common oscillator waveform continuously from saw through square and pulse shapes.

controls.label: Detune range
controls.description: Scales interval detuning from unison to twice the original range; the midpoint is Emilie's original spread.

outputs.main: Mono: detuned-pair to dry-primary to hard-sync path. Stereo: a nearby left point on that crossfade.
outputs.aux: Mono: detuned secondary oscillator. Stereo: a nearby right point on the detune-to-sync crossfade.

trigger: The oscillator phases free-run; patched TRIG restarts Plaits' shared decay and low-pass-gate envelope.
upstream: Mutable Instruments eurorack Plaits source, original VA_VARIANT 1 with Plaits Palette macro and stereo integration
